title: Do not send full top-level `TransportNodesAction` request to individual nodes
body:
Expanding on #99744, there are several other `TransportNodesAction` implementations which send requests to the individual nodes each of which contains a copy of the top-level request, including all the irrelevant and heavyweight `DiscoveryNode` objects resulting from resolving the requested nodes. We should trim these down:

- [x] Deprecate the bad constructor to avoid it proliferating further (see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109513)
- [x] `org.elasticsearch.action.admin.cluster.node.hotthreads.TransportNodesHotThreadsAction.NodeRequest`
  - [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109616
  - [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109665
- [x] `org.elasticsearch.action.admin.cluster.node.reload.NodesReloadSecureSettingsRequest.NodeRequest` (see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/103757)
- [x] `org.elasticsearch.action.admin.cluster.node.stats.TransportNodesStatsAction.NodeStatsRequest` (see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/102559)
- [x] `org.elasticsearch.action.admin.cluster.node.usage.TransportNodesUsageAction.NodeUsageRequest` (see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109665)
- [x] `org.elasticsearch.action.admin.cluster.stats.TransportClusterStatsAction.ClusterStatsNodeRequest` (see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109512)
- [x] `org.elasticsearch.test.seektracker.TransportSeekStatsAction#newNodeRequest` (see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109600)
- [x] `org.elasticsearch.xpack.deprecation.NodesDeprecationCheckAction.NodeRequest` (see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109512)
- [ ] Finally, remove the de/serialization code from `BaseNodesRequest`
  - [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/100867
  - [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109682
  - [ ] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/109783
